name: Samuels Family LA-HIP High School Internship
org: Children's Hospital Los Angeles, The Saban Research Institute
what_you_do: Do real lab research full time for 7 weeks in a scientist's lab at the hospital. Then share your results at a science day. You also get college counseling, SAT prep and biology classes all through senior year.
who_can_apply: Current juniors at a public high school in Los Angeles County. You need papers to work legally in California. You should have strong grades and a real interest in science.
pay_detail: Stipend, plus a Metro card and meals at the hospital. The page does not give the amount.
duration: Summer lab work, 9 a.m. to 5 p.m., Monday to Friday, for 7 weeks. College counseling runs from April through senior year.
deadline_text: Last cycle the application opened Nov 3, 2025 and closed Feb 1, 2026. Offers went out in late March. The 2027 dates are not posted yet, so expect a similar window from November to February.
how_to_apply: Apply online. You need an essay, a transcript and one letter from a science or math teacher or a counselor. Your letter is only asked for after the rest is done, so finish early. Info sessions are held in November and January.
notes: Very competitive. If you accept, you must turn down all other summer programs and go to every required meeting. The page mixes dates from different years, so check it again in November. Questions: Danielle Nunez, danunez@chla.usc.edu. Ask whether you need a work permit for the stipend.
